title: Spacious and Modern Home Minutes from Downtown
description:
Feel the charm of East Nashville living while enjoying modern luxuries in a central location. Share this spacious house with family and friends. Prepare full meals and dine indoors or out, enjoy the large backyard, then take a quick 7-10 minute Uber/Lyft to downtown Nashville.

***Note: we do not rent to locals for staycations or for hosting parties***

The space
You have access to the entire home when you stay with us. It is an immaculately-kept house with modern touches. It is spacious and perfect for families. 

If you want to take advantage of the great Nashville weather, there is a back deck for dining al fresco and a grill to make the perfect summertime meal. A small fire pit and large backyard is also available for our guests.

Guest access
Our guests can use the entire property during their stay. Whether it’s relaxing on the front porch or back deck, to playing catch or having a bon fire in the backyard, our place has every detail to make your stay special.

Other things to note
We have a gravel driveway that can accommodate 1-3 vehicles. We welcome guests to park their vehicles in this location.
